invariants.rationale: The method always returns a (possibly empty) List, never null.
The method either returns the input list (possibly sorted) or the same reference when empty.
By method contract, records should not be null as it is passed in from the caller.
The returned list is either the very same list or a sorted version thereof, never removing or adding elements.
The number of output partitions should never be negative (likely contract from calling code).
